summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K reporting partial execution of a share capital reduction approved at the March 20, 2026 shareholder meeting. The company canceled 52,800,888 treasury shares (€0.49 par value each) totaling €25,872,435.12 in nominal amount, acquired under the second tranche of a share repurchase program announced March 20, 2026 and completed April 17, 2026. No price per share or premium is stated as the cancellation does not involve a return of contributions. The reduction is charged to unrestricted reserves with a reserve for redeemed capital created. No creditor opposition rights apply under Spanish law. BBVA will request delisting of the canceled shares from stock exchanges and IBERCLEAR. This is a non-U.S. filing equivalent to a capital return via share cancellation. Watch for completion of the final delisting and any impact on liquidity.
